incident_brief: Baseline SRE triage. Read-only. Report top 5 observations with evidence.
incident_window: 2026-08-17T09:49Z (mmd-questdb container start) to 2026-08-19T04:15Z (observability snapshot) — reported symptom window; outage (QuestDB equities candle freshness 2/4) spanned >=24h to 08-19T04:15Z
method: read-only probes: git log/show/branch (infra mirror), docker ps/inspect/logs, grep of prometheus.yml; probe commands cited per finding
summary: No in-window change (git commit, image build, or deploy) touched the QuestDB/candle data path. The equities candle freshness outage (fresh=2/4; NQ=F/YM=F stale) is feed-side: mmd-snapshot-feed & mmd-data-feed both Up 4d from the SAME mmd-python:latest build created 2026-08-15T00:36Z — no candle-path deploy in window. mmd-questdb restarted 2026-08-17T09:49Z on an unchanged questdb/questdb:latest image (created 2026-03-26), 12GiB memory cap, no image change in window; its logs show steady WAL-apply/o3-merge (no crash loop). The only in-window change train is the api-gateway KAN-58 lane-B (#321-#330, 08-18T19:05Z->08-19T05:07Z), deployed clean (infra-api-gateway Up since 08-18T17:12:49Z, restarts=0, /health /metrics 200) and confined to the api-gateway service. Two config-drift defects correlate with alert noise, NOT with the candle outage: (a) stale scrape target ext-papers:8006 in HEAD prometheus.yml L86 (comment L89 'stays down by design') keeps up==0=1 -> ServiceDown + observability-gate=0; fix eb71393 'drop stale scrape' exists ONLY on branch xt/p35r (unmerged) — HEAD predates it; (b) mmd-questdb on json-file log driver with no rotation config, json.log 23.9GiB (ContainerJsonLogTooLarge) — infra compose ships default-logging, mercury-market-data compose does not. 3rd orphan tsdb_repro_t80he (bridge, default POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres, no healthcheck, no compose labels, created/started 2026-07-28T17:22:59Z) confirmed; 2 legacy debug orphans (bold_tesla 08-01T17:55Z, nice_meninsky 07-28T13:14Z) confirmed. Swap 95.7% escalation (inflection ~08-19T00:30Z) is host-pressure correlation with QuestDB CPU ramp (170->345% at 08-18T19:00Z) and KAN-58 deploy train — correlational only, no causal link established to the candle outage.

HIGH confidence defect; MEDIUM-HIGH confidence fix should merge (reconcile comment L89 with the removal, or silence alert).
